# Mogen

> Mogen (Motsoane Global Enterprise (Pty) Ltd) is a South African digital services business for small and growing companies: custom web development engineered to convert, SEO built on a proprietary 37-step framework, digital marketing management, and business documentation. Offices in Maboloka (North West), Soshanguve (Gauteng) and Centurion (Pretoria); serves greater Pretoria, Brits and the North West. Reply-within-one-business-day promise; prices published plainly, no bundled jargon, no inflated claims.

## What it does

- **Web development** — custom websites engineered to convert visitors into customers; fast, mobile-first, with clear enquiry paths.
- **SEO** — Google Business Profile, local grid mapping, technical + on-page work via a 37-step, 4-band framework (Critical / Reactive / Strategic / Deferred bands).
- **Digital marketing** — content strategy, social media management, paid ads, email.
- **Business documentation** — policies, procedures, forms, templates and related documents, delivered print-ready and editable.

## Who it is for

Owners of small and growing South African businesses — the practice, the shop, the clinic, the contractor, the retailer.

## Pricing

All prices as published on the site (October 2026), in South African rand (R):

Web development:
- **Seed** — R99 once-off (promo; was R199): starter website structure, mobile-first, contact/enquiry path.
- **Sprout** — R299/month + R900 setup for the first 12 months (promo; was R399/mo + R1,200): designed starter website, hosting, maintenance, support, up to 5 email accounts, launch-ready SEO structure.
- **Vegetative** — R1,500/month + R2,000 setup: unlimited pages, e-commerce/booking, schema & A/B-test ready, priority support, dedicated project lead.
- Web add-ons: extra page R650 · blog R1,500 · e-commerce R6,500 (up to 50 products) · copywriting R450/page.

SEO:
- **Ignition** — R8,500/mo: core 17 of 37 steps, local grid mapping (Pretoria), Core Web Vitals remediation.
- **Scale** — R16,500/mo: all 37 steps, schema, competitor backlink work (recommended).
- **Dominance** — R32,000/mo: aggressive remedy, multi-location, executive briefs.
- SEO add-ons: extra location R2,500/mo · landing page R2,900 · content R650/article · backlink audit R3,500.

Digital marketing:
- **Starter** R3,500/mo · **Growth** R7,500/mo · **Dominate** R15,000/mo.
- Add-ons: extra platform R1,500/mo · influencer outreach R3,500 · landing page R2,900 · extra ad-spend management 15% of spend.

Business documentation:
- **Essential** R1,900 · **Standard** R4,500 · **Complete** from R4,900.
- Add-ons: extra document R750 · template conversion R650 · procedure manual R2,500 · form design R550.

## FAQ (verbatim)

- **How long does a website take to build?** A Seed site typically launches in 2 weeks, Sprout in 3–4 weeks, and Vegetative depends on scope. We confirm a timeline after the discovery call.
- **Is SEO included?** Every site ships with on-page SEO foundations and Google Search Console setup. For ongoing ranking work, see our SEO service.
- **Will my site work on mobile?** Yes — every build is mobile-first and tested across devices, with Core Web Vitals optimised for speed.
- **Do you offer hosting?** We can set up and manage hosting or hand off to your provider. Ask about our monthly care plans.
- **Can I edit the site myself?** Yes — Sprout and Vegetative builds include a CMS and a training session so you can edit content.
- **How long until I see results?** Technical fixes can lift rankings within weeks; compounding content and authority work typically shows clear movement in 3–6 months.
- **Do you guarantee #1 rankings?** No reputable SEO guarantees #1 — Google's algorithm changes. We guarantee a rigorous process, transparent reporting and measurable progress.
- **Is this for local or national SEO?** Both. Ignition focuses on local Pretoria visibility; Scale and Dominance expand to national and multi-location.
- **What's the 37-step framework?** Our proprietary process covering crawl, indexation, content, links, technical, local and reporting — explore it on seo.mogen.co.za.
- **Do you write the content?** Yes — SEO content writing is included in Scale and Dominance, and available as an add-on for Ignition.
- **Which platforms do you manage?** Facebook, Instagram, X, LinkedIn, TikTok and Google. We recommend the channels where your customers actually are.
- **Is ad spend included?** Packages cover management. Ad budget is separate and we advise on the right spend for your goals.
- **Do you create the content?** Yes — we handle design, copy and scheduling. You approve everything before it goes live.
- **Is there a minimum contract?** We work month-to-month after an initial 3-month setup period, so campaigns have time to compound.
- **How do you report?** A clear monthly report covering reach, engagement, leads and cost-per-result — no vanity metrics.
- **What types of documents do you create?** Policies, procedures, forms, templates, manuals and related business documents — structured for clarity and consistency.
- **Do you handle specialist logo or graphic design?** Business Documentation focuses on structured documents. Where specialist brand or graphic design is needed, we coordinate with trusted external providers.
- **What files do I receive?** You receive a print-ready PDF and an editable source file, formatted consistently across your document set.
- **Can you work from my existing documents?** Yes — we can refine and reformat existing documents into a consistent, professional system.
- **Do you include printing?** We deliver print-ready files. Printing can be arranged via a partner provider if required.
